urls.description: Customizing an open model has meant renting a cluster and paying for idle GPUs, so most teams default to frontier APIs. A smaller open model trained on your own data can beat a frontier model on cost, latency, and task accuracy, and a NeoCloud like Crusoe now runs the whole loop, dataset to endpoint, without cluster ops. This session runs it live, covers what production demands beyond a demo, and looks at where post-training is heading.
